notes: The layout maker has type controls: Size scales every reading on the strip together so the steps between a label, a support and a hero are kept; Hero raises only the large reading on top of that; Thickness moves the whole set lighter or…
Thickness moves in whole typeface weights rather than in numbers, because anything smaller than a whole weight is rounded away and paints no differently.
The typeface itself is chosen in the maker too, from the faces the theme actually ships.
All four apply to the preview and to the desktop at the same moment, and there is one button to put them back to the defaults.
